dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, jagged light-colored perimeters forming closed 'O' and open 'C' shapes with sharp gradients transitioning into darker centers. Prominent rings on the upper mid-dorsal region show high pixel intensity at the boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of scattered, non-circular light pixel clusters located primarily along the anterior neck region and ventral-lateral margins, exhibiting high core intensity without central gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A series of three large, distinct annuli on the upper dorsal flank form an obtuse scalene triangle, with smaller satellite rings creating a secondary linear alignment extending towards the posterior.

other_distinctive_markers: Labyrinthine, interconnected light-colored lines forming a continuous complex network across the central lateral surface, bridging several larger ring structures.
